verdict.rationale: LangSmith documents automating workflows with rules, webhooks, and online evaluations. Online evaluators run automatically on production traces, with filters and sampling. Threshold-based alerts on run count, cost, errors, feedback score, and latency support stacked filter conditions and route to Slack, PagerDuty, or any HTTP webhook. Together these clearly deliver condition-triggered automatic actions. Missing for 10: detailed docs on the automation-rules feature itself (its action types and trigger conditions beyond a one-line mention), and independent or hands-on corroboration of rule-based automation.
